blurb:
The lights have gone dark on the Las Vegas Strip. As a musician chasing your dream, it's up to you to bring the entertainment back, guided by the ghosts of the Rat Pack themselves.

Frank Sinatra, Dean Martin, Sammy Davis Jr., and the rest lead you through 11 iconic landmarks. Solve riddles, decode hidden messages, and collect five mystical artifacts to restore Vegas to its former glory.

How it works: download the Questo app, activate your quest with the booking code, and start playing when you reach the MGM Grand. No guide, no schedule, just explore at your own pace and pause whenever you like.

You'll uncover stories most tourists walk past: the MGM Grand's Wizard of Oz origins, how New York-New York became a 9/11 memorial, the mafia ties behind Planet Hollywood, and a 40-foot Burning Man sculpture hidden between the casinos.

Perfect for couples, friends, or families looking for something beyond the usual Vegas tour. About 90 minutes, 11 stops along the Strip.
